data.description: Follow-up of PQ-27 (PR #38, merged at a599e80). Source: artifact art_01M3Z8N3FYVWJW0H8JFBMWT73V on PQ-27. (A) MAJOR, F-47: the lint's prose_fields (pipeline/src/popquiz/copylint.py:157-180) reads explains.what, explains.takeaway, why_tempting and hint - SPEC's list - but not trace.steps[].note, generated prose that the wall, host and take-it-home all show; AC-98 covers every participant-facing string and outranks SPEC's list. Extend prose_fields (and the JS twin) to trace.steps[].note with fixtures in bank/fixtures/copy-lint; both implementations must agree; SPEC's field list goes upstream as F-47 (do not edit the contract). (B) Freeze blind spots (web/test/copy-freeze.test.js): :118 strips each marker with its filled placeholder, so the MONTHS literal (web/home/home.js:60-68, the date heading) is invisible - declare it in the allowlist or route it through copy.js; allowlist entry 1 (:312-316, the host status line) has no words filter, so any literal assigned to host ui.status passes - add words; COPY_FIELDS (:85) treats any new room copy field as data - pin the field list; list every limit (including common words counted as data on take-it-home and static) in web/shared/README.md instead of 'two entries'. (C) Lint bypasses in both languages (copylint.js:95-97, copylint.py:126-129): collapse whitespace, apply NFKC, strip zero-width characters and normalize apostrophe and dash variants in normalize, quote from the normalized text, and add fixtures for each probe (newline, double space, NBSP, zero-width, U+02BC, backtick, fullwidth letters, -- and ' - '). (D) copylint.py:193-194 turns a lint crash into [] which reads as clean (pinned by tests/test_copylint.py:179-183): return a sentinel warning and pin that instead. (E) tests/test_copylint.py:199 prints the matched prose fragment to CI logs: print the rule id and field only, so a private bank never leaks prose into logs. NITs: retyped pattern lists at web/test/home.test.js:277-289, room/tests/phase_table.rs:255 and copy-freeze.test.js:464 (pin to one source where cheap); README.md:50-51 should say check, well and trace need copy.js at call time; room/tests/twins.rs:403-412 scans only the top level of room/src (walk src/bin too). q3's hint trips the signpost trope: a correct warning, the client's call, leave it. Acceptance: AC-98, AC-57..AC-60; just test green and under 60 s; each new check shown failing under its mutation; both lint implementations agree on every fixture. Harness: just test-web, just test (pipeline).

DISPATCH PQ-42 (Orchestrator, 2026-10-16 ~17:5x EDT) [autonomy: Moderate]. Mode inline-full, Opus delegator, Sonnet reviews. Rulings: (1) F-47 per the RULING above. (2) Both lints agree on every fixture under bank/fixtures/copy-lint/; a fixture one flags and the other does not fails both suites; a notes fixture and one per normalization probe. (3) Normalization in both normalize functions: whitespace runs incl. NBSP/newline to one space, NFKC, zero-width stripped, apostrophe variants (U+2019, U+02BC, backtick) and dash variants (--, ' - ', U+2013, U+2014) folded; match and quote from the normalized text. (4) A lint crash returns one sentinel warning (rule id lint-error, field, exception class, no prose), never []; the test pins the sentinel. (5) Tests print rule id and field only; a guard fails if prose reaches the logs. (6) Freeze blind spots: MONTHS stays in home.js and is declared in the allowlist with a words filter (routing through copy.js would touch the frozen copy twin and room/src/copy.rs, neither cleared); entry 1 gains a words filter; COPY_FIELDS pinned to an explicit list; web/shared/README.md lists every limit. (7) NITs where cheap; room/tests/phase_table.rs and room/tests/twins.rs cleared for those lines only; nothing under room/src/. (8) q3's hint stays; no question text changes. (9) No copy changes, no new copy keys; a new check that flags a frozen string or a real note is a finding for DONE, not an edit. (10) Every new check shown failing under its mutation, bounded at 15 min; just test under 60 s warm; test-full once; bank-audit unchanged. Cleared files: copylint.py, test_copylint.py, bank/fixtures/copy-lint/**, web/test/copylint.js, web/test/copylint.test.js, web/test/copy-freeze.test.js, web/test/home.test.js (NIT lines), web/shared/README.md, web/README.md (README NIT), room/tests/phase_table.rs and room/tests/twins.rs (NIT lines only). Not: web/shared/copy.js, room/src/**, web/home/home.js, bank/questions/**, review/verify/bank.py, justfile, the contract documents.
